title: [2.8.0.1_dev] wear: cannot disable vibration during bolus
symptom: Using 2.8.0.1_dev build fb1a4d40b-2021.01.11, the watch vibrates every 0.2u during bolus even though 'vibrate on bolus' is off. The user finds the repeated vibrations annoying and wants to disable them completely.
cause: The reason behind always vibrating was that watches wouldn't show the notification as popup reliably if it was not together with a vibration, so a non-noticable vibration pattern (vibrate one millisecond every second) was used.
fix: The user resolved it by updating to the latest Dev and removing and reinstalling the watch app, ensuring settings are correct. Additionally, a comment suggests on Wear: Open settings > Apps and Notifications > Notifications > All > Select AAPS > Switch off 'AAPS Bolus progress'.
evidence_quote: The reason behind always vibrating was (4 years ago) that watches wouldn't show the notification as popup reliably if it was not together with a vibration. We therefore used a non-noticable vibration pattern (vibrate one millisecond every second).
